title: Palak Paneer-Style Spinach with Halloumi
subtitle: with cumin, tomato and garam masala
description: A quick Indian-style spinach curry with golden halloumi cubes standing in for paneer, finished with garam masala and fresh coriander.

steps.text: Heat a pan with 2 tablespoons of oil and brown the halloumi cubes on both sides. Transfer to paper towel and set aside.

Heat the remaining oil in another pan and fry the cumin seeds with the garlic and ginger paste for about 20 seconds. Add the chopped tomatoes, turmeric and salt and cook for 5 minutes or until the tomatoes turn into a sauce. Add the chopped spinach and cook for 3-4 minutes until slightly wilted.
Add the halloumi and cook for another 2-3 minutes. Add the garam masala, stir, top with chopped coriander and serve immediately.
